_doc: Tournaments fought in person on a town's street map (systems/lists.js rules; world/innerMap/lists.js the field; ui/innerMapTournament.js the lists themselves). schedule: the towns' own tournaments — every periodDays a town of a listed type holds one with chance[type], on a day of the period hashed from the town (never the shared RNG); announceDays before it the herald cries it; the lists stand from openHour to closeHour. prize[type]: the champion's purse for a town's own tournament (paid by the sponsor: the crown for a capital, else the town's market purse — what it can pay); feeShare: the entry fee as a share of the purse (whole gold, at least minFee), paid into the sponsor's purse. hireHorse: the gold a destrier from the town's stables costs for the day (to the town). joust: the lance-meter — chargeSeconds a pass takes, the strike window round impactAt (window, widened by skill, horse and armour: perSkill a combat level over 1, ownHorse, perArmour of armour), aimSwing how far the lance tip wobbles (steadied by perSkillAim), missBelow the strike quality under which the lance misses; a hit's force against the seat (seat: base + perDefense + perArmour) decides glance / broken lance / unhorsed (unhorseOver, breakOver, the margin over the seat); points per glance and broken lance; passes the best of, maxPasses with tie-breaks; harm: the share of the bout pool a lance landed on you costs (for Duels.settleTournament's harm). ai: an opponent's strike — timing spread falls with their attack, aim spread with their skill. melee: yieldAt the share of health a fighter yields at (no one dies in the lists), hpScale the knight's bout health from their duel hp, forfeitDistance how far from the ring walking away forfeits the bout. wager: the stake on yourself, odds from your strength against the field (minOdds..maxOdds), paid to and from the bookie's own purse. crowd: mood steps per result. watch: the AI passes played out while you watch (secondsBetween).

herald: Hear ye! The lists are open!
